observations: Single blue industrial machine with two hinged cabinet doors open, showing an interior frame with tooling at the top.
A control panel with buttons and a small digital display is mounted on the front, inside one of the open doors.
The unit sits on caster wheels and has ventilation grilles on the top section.
A small sticker/label is visible on the top front corner but is too small and blurred to read any text or model number.
Background shows what appears to be a yard with other equipment or a truck, suggesting an industrial/warehouse setting.
No brand name, model number, serial plate, capacity rating, or voltage/power spec is legible anywhere in the photo.

claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows a control panel but no running operation or automation cycle; 'automatic' cannot be confirmed from a static image.

claims.claim: used in production to make pet plastic bottles of different [sizes]
claims.evidence: No bottles, molds, or output samples are visible in photo 0 to confirm prior production use or size range capability.

risks.risk: Working condition of the machine (heating, blow/stretch cycle, hydraulics/pneumatics) cannot be confirmed from a still photo.
risks.proof: A video clip of the machine running a full molding cycle and ejecting a bottle.

risks.risk: Machine capacity, cavity count, and bottle size range (major price drivers) are unknown since no nameplate is readable.
risks.proof: A clear close-up photo of the manufacturer's nameplate/spec sticker showing model, cavity count, and max bottle size/output rate.

risks.risk: Completeness of mold set and tooling (molds are often sold separately or missing) cannot be verified.
risks.proof: Photo of the mold(s) currently fitted to or included with the machine.
risks.if_unproven: priced as machine only, without molds

risks.risk: Electrical specification (voltage/phase) and compatibility with local power is unknown.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the power rating plate or control panel spec label.
risks.if_unproven: priced assuming unknown/non-standard power requirement, lowering value

risks.risk: Age, hours of use, and maintenance history are unverifiable from a single exterior photo.
risks.proof: Photos of internal components (heater bands, blow pins, hydraulic pump) plus any service/maintenance log.
risks.if_unproven: priced as heavily used, near end-of-life condition

risks.risk: Hidden damage or missing internal parts behind the closed/obscured sections of the cabinet.
risks.proof: Additional photos with all panels fully open showing complete internal assembly.
risks.if_unproven: priced assuming parts may be missing or damaged

proof_requests: Clear photo of the nameplate/spec sticker (model, cavity count, voltage, output rate).
Video of the machine running a full cycle producing a bottle.
Photo of the mold(s) included with the sale.
Wide photo with all panels open showing full internal mechanism.
Any maintenance or purchase documentation showing age and usage history.
response.reason: This is complex industrial machinery whose price swings enormously with capacity, cavity count, and automation level, none of which are legible in the single photo provided, so even a worst-case figure cannot be set without a readable nameplate or spec proof.
